set.body:
Plan: docs/institutional-readiness-plan.md
Work key: Q02
Accountable role (person not assigned): Independent reviewer and representative users

Outcome: The institutional collaboration and interface claims have independent and human acceptance evidence.

Acceptance:
- Review and exercise current role/action boundaries, denied discovery/counts, session/grant expiry, revocation, restricted source/report leakage and selected browser-session protections.
- Have representative curators/researchers complete import, organization, correction/conflict recovery, sharing and retrieval; resolve blocking findings.
- Complete actual screen-reader/keyboard evidence including CON-03; record reviewer, versions, source state, outcomes and unresolved limitations. Automated checks cannot stand in for missing human results.

Evidence anchors:
- docs/evidence/console/adoption.json
- docs/http-api.md

Status: planned; no implementation or qualification claimed.
set.title: Q02: Close access review and human usability adoption gates
